The '''attack''' on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[X7-Cratus]] occurred in [[3629 BBY]]<ref name="Year" /> when rogue [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] started developing [[RS-33]], an unstable [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]], to create a new army. The [[Eternal Alliance]] [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] attacked the station and stopped the lead scientist, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Alirra Semhess]].<ref name="TAE" />
